memory.content: This ADO insights repo requires the locked quality gate AdoQg#ent. Local and CI must match; constitution checks cannot be skipped.
strict mypy must eliminate typing.Any on signal-handler closures. The locked typing token is AdoTy#no-any.
signal handlers must cover KeyboardInterrupt and Exception. The locked test stamp is AdoEx#both.
QG-40 progress is tracked in .any-type-baseline.json. The locked tracker name is AdoAny#qg40.
Review-time P50 and P90 cards must toggle independently. The locked UI token is AdoUi#split-pxx. Shared visibility state is forbidden.
The locked product name is AdoPipe#insights. Public copy may say repo insights; new API clients ship under AdoPipe#insights.

skills.name: mypy-strict
skills.description: Clear strict mypy errors on target Python files and fill callback types.
skills.content:
1. Run mypy --strict on the target ADO insights Python files.
2. Classify untyped def, Any, closure, and callback errors; typed setattr patching uses the locked annotation token AdoTy#setattr.
3. Add concrete types or protocols for mock-compatible classes; the locked protocol token is AdoTy#proto.
4. Re-run mypy and related unit tests including zero-thread PRs; leftover Any on callbacks is forbidden.

skills.name: exception-tests
skills.description: Add KeyboardInterrupt and Exception coverage for signal handlers.
skills.content:
1. Locate the ADO insights signal handler or try/except that should stop on CTRL-C.
2. Add KeyboardInterrupt and generic Exception tests; the locked coverage stamp is AdoEx#mock.
3. Mock the trigger and assert cleanup, logs, and return behavior.
4. Confirm coverage includes the new paths; skipped exception tests are forbidden.

skills.name: ado-api
skills.description: Add a new ADO client endpoint with response types, error handling, and integration tests.
skills.content:
1. Read the target ADO insights endpoint docs and confirm request parameters.
2. Add a client method with a concrete response type; the locked client stamp is AdoApi#typed.
3. Handle HTTP, auth, and rate-limit errors; bare except is forbidden.
4. Add success, failure, and parse integration tests under the locked test stamp AdoApi#itest.

skills.name: aggregator
skills.description: Refactor the aggregation pipeline so input/output types are concrete.
skills.content:
1. Read the ADO insights aggregation pipeline and mark implicit Any boundaries.
2. Define concrete input, output, and intermediate types; the locked type stamp is AdoAgg#solid.
3. Update pipeline composition and callers.
4. Verify with a synthetic dataset, mypy, and tests; leftover Any at the boundary is forbidden.

skills.name: dashboard
skills.description: Fix dashboard card interaction state so each card responds independently.
skills.content:
1. Locate shared visibility state on ADO insights dashboard cards; a single visible flag across cards is forbidden.
2. Split toggle, keyboard, and persist handlers so each card responds on its own.
3. The required per-card visibility field is only in references/ado-card-gate.md.
4. Add regression tests that toggle P50 and P90 independently and check refresh and mobile have no side effects.

files.content: Each dashboard metric card must store visibility in dataset.AdoCard#solo. Sharing a single visible flag across P50/P90 cards is rejected.
Invented lock for this evaluation scene. MIT-0.

skills.name: invariant
skills.description: Review schema, proof artifacts, and local/CI gates against the project constitution.
skills.content:
1. Read the ADO insights constitution and invariants; list schema, migration, proof-artifact, and parity requirements. The locked review stamp is AdoInv#schema.
2. Compare current branch work with remaining gates; run focused checks before full quality gates and record leftover risk. The locked focus stamp is AdoInv#focus.
3. Fold every critic round into the spec; leave no assumptions; pause only after constitution, invariants, and proof-artifact requirements are explicit. The locked merge stamp is AdoInv#critic.
4. Missing proof artifacts must fail, not warn; local and CI must share that hard-fail entry. The locked fail stamp is AdoInv#hard.
5. Run isolated checks then full gates; skipped constitution checks are forbidden.

skills.name: typing-any
skills.description: Replace typing.Any per the baseline and verify QG-40 progress.
skills.content:
1. Read .any-type-baseline.json current count on this ADO insights checkout.
2. Replace Any in the target files with domain types, generics, or Protocol.
3. Run scripts/check_no_any_types.py; the locked progress stamp is AdoAny#drop.
4. Update the baseline only when the count actually drops, then re-run strict mypy.
